items.name: Danish Special 2013

venue.name: University of Copenhagen
venue.details: Top floor, in the cantina, there will be signs to follow.

items.information: Danish Special 2013 is a biannual competition. This year we will have Skewb, 15 sliding puzzle, 2 secret events and the traditional "stafet" beside the official events. You don't have to sign up for unofficial events.

items.name: Nelidovo Open 2013

venue.name: School No 3
venue.address: Russia, Tver Region, Nelidovo, Pravdy street 17

items.information: Registration will be opened on January,15 and closed on March,17 or when we reach 100 competitors. Please, pay attention to the [registration rules](http://speedcubing.ru/nelidovoopen2013/)

items.name: Stockholm Open 2013

venue.name: Tekniska museet (Museum of science)
venue.details: In the big hall beside the restaurant on the entrance floor

items.information: Open to everyone and participate fee will be 100SEK. Late Registration may be done on site on the competition day but will cost 20SEK extra per event after the first event. Detailed information can be found on the competition's webpage.
